item.title: A tour of this blog: diagrams, math, code
item.description: The first post. Everything this blog can put inside a post, one thing at a time: a figure that follows your place, diagrams drawn at build time, math, code, and two languages.

item.title: Why Hangul takes two columns in a terminal
item.description: Why one Hangul syllable is as wide as two Latin letters, why arrows and box-drawing characters change width from one setup to the next, and why string length is not a column count.

item.title: Redis HyperLogLog: counting a million users in 14 KB
item.description: Counting unique visitors with a SET takes 37 MB for a million; HyperLogLog takes 14 KB. How it counts, and how far off it is, measured.
